newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Matash, Vestcor chastised by JSE.
newsitem.headline: Matash, Vestcor chastised by JSE.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange said on Wednesday that Mathieson & Ashley Holdings Ltd and Vestacor Ltd had not submitted interim financial reports for the period ending August 31 1996.
The companies' listings are presently suspended.
In a statement, the exchange cautioned shareholders that the companies had been informed that the listings of their securities were under threat of termination.

"Should the companies not submit their interim financial reports by the end of December 1996, a special meeting of the general committee of the JSE will be convened to consider the continued suspension or possible termination of their listings," the exchange said.
